sections.heading: Create an online store on your own website.
body: Build an online store with products, Stripe checkout and digital downloads on the same site as your pages and blog, with in-person POS and subscriptions from Pro. Describe your products and Aglyn AI drafts the listings. The store switches on from Starter.

sections.heading: You don’t need a separate storefront platform bolted onto your site. With Aglyn, your store and your site are the same thing — one design, one login, one checkout.

items.title: Products & variants
items.body: Sell physical, digital, and service products with options, variants, and images.

items.title: Checkout & payments
items.body: Stripe-powered checkout with taxes, discounts and coupons, plus gift cards (Pro & up).

items.title: POS & in person
items.body: Ring up sales at the counter with registers; inventory stays in sync (Pro and up).

items.title: Subscriptions
items.body: Offer recurring plans and memberships, billed through Stripe (Pro and up).

items.title: Inventory & orders
items.body: Track stock across locations, and manage orders, refunds, and fulfillment.

items.title: Store analytics
items.body: Revenue, orders, average order value, and top products, built in.

sections.heading: Every order, one stream.
body: Orders from your storefront and your POS land in the same place — track status, issue refunds, and keep inventory honest without leaving the console.

items.title: One order stream
items.body: Online and POS orders land in one list, each with status and fulfillment.

items.title: Refunds through Stripe
items.body: Issue refunds in the console; platform fees adjust automatically.

items.title: Inventory that keeps up
items.body: Stock tracked per location, with oversell rules and restock alerts.

items.title: Add products
items.body: Create your catalog with variants, images, and inventory.

items.title: Design your store
items.body: Drop product grids and a cart onto your site in Besigner.

items.title: Start selling
items.body: Connect Stripe, publish, and take orders online or in person.

items.title: Selling starts on Starter
items.body: Open your store on any paid plan — digital fee 3% on Starter and 1% on Pro.

items.title: POS from Pro
items.body: Ring up in-person sales with 1 register per site on Pro, and add more as you need them.

items.title: Physical fees drop fast
items.body: 1% on Starter, 0% on Pro and Custom — payments through your own Stripe account.

items.title: Commerce
items.body: Storefronts, checkout, POS & digital goods.

items.title: Media
items.body: A real DAM — folders, drag-and-drop, metadata.

items.title: Analytics
items.body: Privacy-first traffic, top pages & store revenue.

sections.heading: Questions about building an online store.
body: What you can sell, what it costs and when the store switches on.

items.title: How do I create an online store on Aglyn?
items.body: Build your site free, then switch on commerce from Starter: add products, connect Stripe and your checkout is live on your own domain.

items.title: What can I sell?
items.body: Physical products, digital downloads and appointment bookings from Starter, and subscriptions from the Pro plan.

items.title: What are the fees?
items.body: Stripe's processing fee on every plan, plus a small Aglyn platform fee on digital goods that falls as you move up and reaches zero on the higher tiers; physical goods carry a small fee only on Starter. See pricing.

items.title: Can I sell in person?
items.body: Yes. In-person POS with inventory kept in sync is included from the Pro plan.

items.title: Can I start free and add the store later?
items.body: Yes. Build the pages on the free plan and switch on commerce when you are ready to sell.

items.title: Do I need Shopify?
items.body: Not when the store is part of a website that also markets and follows up. If selling is the whole business, Shopify is a strong pure-commerce choice; see our Shopify comparison.

items.title: What is Aglyn?
items.body: Aglyn is a website builder with the store, forms, CRM, email, analytics and Aglyn AI built in. It is open source and free to start.

sections.heading: Open your store on Aglyn.
body: Free to start — add products and open your store in minutes.
